title: Customising brain atlases
text: ggseg.formats provides three groups manipulation functions. Region functions (atlas_region_*) control regions active atlas. View functions (atlas_view_*) control 2D sf geometry—views present arranged. Core functions (atlas_core_*) enrich region metadata. accept ggseg_atlas first argument, return new ggseg_atlas, play nicely pipe.

title: Customising brain atlases
text: atlas_region_remove() strips region entirely—core, palette, sf geometry, 3D data. pattern argument passed grepl() ignore.case = TRUE, partial matches work: atlas_region_keep() inverse: keeps regions match turns everything else context geometry (sf preserved surface continuity, non-matching regions leave core palette): functions accept match_on argument choose whether pattern matches "region" (default, human-readable name) "label" (unique identifier):
code: no_cc <- atlas_region_remove(dk(), "corpus callosum") "corpus callosum" %in% atlas_regions(no_cc) #> [1] FALSE frontal <- atlas_region_keep(dk(), "frontal") atlas_regions(frontal) #> [1] "caudalmiddlefrontal"  "frontalpole"          "lateralorbitofrontal" #> [4] "medialorbitofrontal"  "rostralmiddlefrontal" "superiorfrontal" lh_only <- atlas_region_keep(dk(), "^lh_", match_on = "label") head(atlas_labels(lh_only)) #> [1] "lh_bankssts"                "lh_caudalanteriorcingulate" #> [3] "lh_caudalmiddlefrontal"     "lh_corpuscallosum"          #> [5] "lh_cuneus"                  "lh_entorhinal"

title: Customising brain atlases
text: Sometimes want region’s polygon stay visible (rendered grey) appear legend carry data. atlas_region_contextual() . removes region core, palette, 3D data leaves sf geometry place: Compare atlas_region_remove(), delete ventricle polygons entirely, leaving gaps 2D slices.

title: Customising brain atlases
text: atlas_region_rename() changes region column without touching label (geometry links stay intact). Pass fixed string: pass function programmatic renaming:
code: renamed <- atlas_region_rename(   dk(),   "banks of superior temporal sulcus",   "STS banks" ) "STS banks" %in% atlas_regions(renamed) #> [1] FALSE upper <- atlas_region_rename(dk(), ".*", toupper) head(atlas_regions(upper)) #> [1] "BANKSSTS"                "CAUDALANTERIORCINGULATE" #> [3] "CAUDALMIDDLEFRONTAL"     "CORPUSCALLOSUM"          #> [5] "CUNEUS"                  "ENTORHINAL"

title: Customising brain atlases
text: atlas_views() tells 2D views atlas : atlas_view_keep() atlas_view_remove() filter views pattern. want sagittal slice: remove several views passing vector:
code: atlas_views(aseg()) #> [1] "axial_3"   "axial_4"   "axial_5"   "axial_6"   "coronal_1" "coronal_2" #> [7] "sagittal" sag <- atlas_view_keep(aseg(), "sagittal") atlas_views(sag) #> [1] "sagittal" fewer <- atlas_view_remove(aseg(), c("axial_3", "coronal_2")) atlas_views(fewer) #> [1] "axial_4"   "axial_5"   "axial_6"   "coronal_1" "sagittal"

title: Customising brain atlases
text: filtering regions may small polygon fragments left —tiny slivers region just barely crossed slice plane. atlas_view_remove_small() removes region polygons minimum area threshold. Context polygons (core) never removed: can scope removal specific views: atlas_view_remove_region() removes specific region’s sf geometry without touching core, palette, 3D data. useful region’s 2D projection misleading still want 3D:
code: cleaned <- atlas_view_remove_small(aseg(), min_area = 50) #> ℹ Removed 14 geometries below area 50 cleaned_sag <- atlas_view_remove_small(   aseg(),   min_area = 50,   views = "sagittal" ) #> ℹ Removed 4 geometries below area 50 no_stem_sf <- atlas_view_remove_region(   aseg(),   "brain stem",   match_on = "region" )

title: Customising brain atlases
text: remove views, remaining geometry keeps original coordinates, can leave awkward gaps. atlas_view_gather() repositions views side--side configurable gap: atlas_view_reorder() lets choose left--right order repositions time. Views mentioned order appended end:
code: trimmed <- aseg() |>   atlas_view_keep(c("sagittal", "coronal_3", "axial_3")) |>   atlas_view_gather() atlas_views(trimmed) #> [1] "axial_3"  "sagittal" reordered <- aseg() |>   atlas_view_keep(c("sagittal", "coronal_3", "axial_3")) |>   atlas_view_reorder(c("axial_3", "sagittal", "coronal_3")) atlas_views(reordered) #> [1] "axial_3"  "sagittal"

title: Customising brain atlases
text: atlas_core_add() left-joins data frame onto core table. useful attaching grouping variables, statistical results, per-region information. add custom network column handful regions: argument defaults "region" can join shared column.
code: network_info <- data.frame(   region = c(     "superior frontal",     "precuneus",     "inferior parietal",     "posterior cingulate"   ),   network = "default mode" ) enriched <- atlas_core_add(dk(), network_info) enriched$core[!is.na(enriched$core$network), c("region", "network")] #>       region      network #> 25 precuneus default mode #> 60 precuneus default mode

title: The ggseg_atlas object
text: ggseg.formats ships three atlases illustrate three types. Cortical atlases like dk parcellate cortical surface. data object ggseg_data_cortical containing sf polygons 2D rendering vertex indices 3D: Subcortical atlases like aseg represent deep brain structures. data ggseg_data_subcortical sf polygons individual 3D meshes: Tract atlases like tracula represent white matter bundles. data ggseg_data_tract sf polygons centerlines generate tube meshes 3D: every case sf component drives 2D plotting type-specific component (vertices, meshes, centerlines) drives 3D.

title: Manipulate brain atlas regions and views — atlas_manipulation
text: atlas_region_contextual(): Keep geometry visual context remove core, palette, 3D data. Context geometries render grey appear legends. Contextual rows moved behind remaining core regions focus regions draw top overlap projection. Operates whichever 2D representation atlas carries (sf /polygons), keeping sync, needs sf polygon atlas. atlas_region_op(): Combine two sets region geometry vector boolean operation (per view), writing result new region . x y patterns matched match_on; within view matching geometries unioned, combined via action: "difference" (x minus y, e.g. punching white matter cortex silhouette), "intersection", "union", "symdifference". Inputs left place; existing geometry replaced. colour, becomes legended core region; otherwise stays contextual (grey) drawn behind core regions. Boolean ops need geometry engine, one manipulation helper always requires sf installed; polygon-atlas rehydrated operation result returned polygon form. atlas_context_remove(): Drop contextual sf geometry — every sf row whose label present core. Covers labels marked via atlas_region_contextual() plus pipeline-generated outlines (cortex_, Background, unknown). Remaining views re-packed via atlas_view_gather() plot focuses tightly labelled regions. atlas_region_rename(): Rename regions matching pattern. affects region column, label. replacement function, receives matched names returns new names. atlas_region_keep(): Keep matching regions. Non-matching regions removed core, palette, 3D data sf geometry preserved surface continuity. atlas_core_add(): Join additional metadata columns atlas core. atlas_view_remove(): Remove views matching pattern sf data. Remaining views re-packed via atlas_view_gather() layout stays tight. atlas_view_keep(): Keep views matching pattern. atlas_view_remove_region(): Remove specific region geometry sf data . Core, palette, 3D data unchanged. Views re-packed via atlas_view_gather() case view shrank. atlas_view_remove_small(): Remove geometry minimum area threshold. scope = "region" (default) label's whole geometry view removed combined area small, context geometries (labels core) never removed. scope = "piece" individual disconnected pieces removed rest region stays – use clear stray specks left volumetric projection. region's largest piece view always kept, region disappears, context cleaned . Optionally scope specific views. Views re-packed via atlas_view_gather() case view shrank. atlas_view_select(): Keep region views show well. slice projection slab catches structure cross-section readily along length, regions leave sliver views. leaves every panel cluttered every region drawn several times . region kept substantially represented: view holding least threshold area reaches best view. Regions compared whole, across labels share region core, bilateral structures stay together – assigning left right independently splits pairs across panels, reads error rather choice. Every region guaranteed survive least one view, context geometry (labels absent core, cortical outline) never touched. Single-hemisphere views awkward case: sagittal panel cuts one hemisphere axial coronal panels show , raw area loses every comparison empties . views detected hemispheres actually present view areas scaled match, compete fairly. Pass weights override. atlas_view_gather(): Reposition remaining views close gaps view removal. atlas_view_reorder(): Reorder views reposition. Views order appended end.
